scope: Development camera-only bundle pilot using DA3 initial estimates, existing RGB-only SIFT tracks and fixed spatial bands; 3 analytic image cases and 4 known rod scenes; no corrected dense base or rod-efficacy claim
limits: One known analytic positive layout, not an independent rod asset
Shared focal multiplier cannot model arbitrary per-view calibration error or distortion
The first pose and first-last baseline fix gauge only, not metric calibration
Heldout matches diagnose projection generalization, not physical identity
Injected corruption is training-only and does not replace naturally wrong matches
No privileged cameras initialize the optimizer
